Basic web search request with a simple query

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.search_async(LiterLlm::SearchRequest.new(model: 'brave/web-search', query: 'What is Rust programming language?'))
puts result.inspect
```
